# iru_blueprints (Data Source)

Look up Iru blueprints, optionally filtered by name. Use the returned `id` for `blueprint_id` on assignments.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "iru_blueprints" "core" {
  name = "Core"
}

# Reference the matching ID:
#   one(data.iru_blueprints.core.results).id
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `name` (String) If set, only blueprints whose name exactly matches are returned.

### Read-Only

- `results` (Attributes List) Matching blueprints. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--results))

<a id="nestedatt--results"></a>
### Nested Schema for `results`

Read-Only:

- `computers_count` (Number) Number of devices on the blueprint.
- `description` (String) Blueprint description.
- `id` (String) Blueprint ID.
- `name` (String) Blueprint name.
- `type` (String) Blueprint type, `classic` or `map`.
